harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: 42 requests of probe.py 34 (twelfth build), all kind raw, six grids (1, 8, 9, 12 and 16 warps per SM, and 2 CTAs of 9 warps per SM), 40 repetitions: THE YIELD FLAG ON A PRODUCER THAT HOLDS THE DISTANCE TO ITS FIXED-LATENCY READER. Fourteen pairs of a producer and the operand of its reader - `SHF -> PRMT.r3` (h_shf_prmt3), `IADD3 -> LEA.r1` (h_iadd3_lea1), `IADD3 -> LEA.r2` (h_iadd3_lea2), `LEA -> IMAD.r3` (h_lea_imad3), `IMAD -> PRMT.r1` (h_imad_prmt1), `PRMT -> LOP3.r1` (h_prmt_lop31), `ISETP -> ISETP.p` (h_isetp_p), `MOV -> QMMA.r1` (h_mov_q1), `MOV -> QMMA.r1h` (h_mov_q1h), `LOP3 -> QMMA.r2` (h_lop3_q2), `SEL -> LOP3.r1` (h_sel_lop31), `VOTEU -> FLO.u1` (h_voteu_flo), `IADD3 -> IADD3.r1` (h_iadd3_iadd3), `IMAD -> IADD3.r1` (h_imad_iadd3) - three requests each: h_<x> = the producer's stall count is the distance to its reader, 1 ... 8 cycles, NO yield flag on it; h_<x>_y = the same text with THE YIELD FLAG ON THE PRODUCER (the word that holds the distance); h_<x>_c = the control: the producer's word stands behind the reader and its checksum, a filler in its place, and the model gives the reader the new content (2 and 7 cycles: it must not be right). Fronts: no word in front, and fifteen `STS.128` at stall 4 in front (for the pairs into a tensor word: no word in front, and one tensor word of the same form on another accumulator at stall 7 in front)

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
conditions.card_state: a Server Edition card (this model takes no clock offset); the probe alone, no power limit

classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
